label: Base AI Project Starter v4
description: Reference-first AI contributor starter with documentation before implementation, repository-wide SSOT, and canonical stored standard markers.

rules.label: No silent fallbacks
rules.description: Do not add hidden fallback chains, heuristic recovery, or implicit compatibility behavior.
rules.evidence_hint: Review summary confirming failure behavior is explicit.

rules.label: Keep authority single-source
rules.description: Require one authoritative owner for each contract, domain fact, state transition, configuration value, parser/mapper/factory, and operation-success postcondition; read-only projections must derive from that owner.
rules.evidence_hint: Reference the canonical owner and record the repository-wide search used to exclude competing active authorities.

rules.label: Test meaningful behavior
rules.description: Test behavior, contracts, and failure handling instead of decorative mocks.
rules.evidence_hint: Command and result summary for the relevant test slice.

rules.label: Documentation before implementation
rules.description: Read-only investigation may precede documentation. Before editing implementation or tests for changes to behavior, architecture, contracts, configuration, commands, deployment or risk, update the canonical docs/specs with responsibility owners, expected behavior and acceptance criteria. If the plan changes, revise those documents before further implementation or test edits. A plan is not evidence of implementation, verification, deployment or acceptance.
rules.evidence_hint: Reference the canonical docs/specs updated before implementation/test edits, identify owners, expected behavior and acceptance criteria, and record documentation-first ordering including plan revisions. Report actual verification and deployment evidence separately.
